description.en: Long-term experience memory for any LLM in DeepSeek Harness: five model tools (search / get / status / save / feedback) plus an interactive 3D star map where zones are nebulae, subzones are clusters, units are stars, and pending proposals fall as clickable meteors. Writes go through the approval service and fail closed; conflicts are kept as pairs; maturity moves only on explicit feedback. No npm dependencies, Python 3.8+ only.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 里任意大模型装上跨会话记忆：五个工具（检索/读原文/概览/沉淀/回写效果），外带一张可交互的 3D 星图——大区是星云、小区是星团、每条经验是一颗星，待批提案化作可点的流星。写入走审批服务、失败关闭；冲突经验成对保留；成熟度只由显式回写推进。无 npm 依赖，只要 Python 3.8+。
